# that is deliberately being kept for now.  Four tab-separated fields:

# was wired, tested, or deleted) - remove the row in the change that made it
# stale.  To renew an expiry, do it deliberately, with a reason that still
# holds.  Baseline generated 2026-09-08 from the tree; rows not tied to a
# ledger task are marked "unreviewed baseline row" and expire together.
